svg.title: Plant Omics Thesis Writing workflow
svg.desc: Set scope — Author-approved baseline — Sections + safeguards; Map claims — Source, unit, comparison — Claim-to-source map; Draft or revise — Results vs. interpretation — Evidence-linked prose; Verify references — Check citations, units, panels — Claims reconciled; Deliver copy — Track changes and gaps — Diff + open issues
